name: tokenwatch
description: Live Claude Code quota in your status bar: 5-hour session and weekly usage with reset countdowns.

tokenwatch.pollIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds between quota refreshes. The usage endpoint's rate limit is shared with Claude Code itself, so polling faster than every few minutes draws 429s. The reset countdown and context still update every 15 seconds. Unfocused windows skip polls and catch up when focused.

tokenwatch.warnThresholdPercent.markdownDescription: The status bar turns amber when either quota reaches this percentage, or when at the current pace a quota will run out within the hour. It turns red at 100%.

tokenwatch.statusBarStyle.markdownDescription: How usage appears in the status bar.

tokenwatch.showResetCountdown.markdownDescription: Show when the 5-hour session resets, for example `↻4h 8m`, in the status bar.

tokenwatch.showContext.markdownDescription: Show how full the context window is (`ctx 29%`) for the latest Claude Code session started in this window's folder.

tokenwatch.contextWindowTokens.markdownDescription: Context window size per model, used for `ctx %`. Keys match an exact model id, a prefix (`"claude-opus"` covers every Opus version), or `"*"` for everything else. Unlisted models assume 200k, or 1M once a session grows past 200k. Example: `{ "claude-opus": 1000000 }`.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
